method: Test copies of V002/V001 with SRC repointed to scratch fixtures. Fixtures = the real MRT header lines (documentation, up to the last separator) + synthetic rows. The real CDS ReadMe is used for documentation verification. A fake Vflat sentinel sits beyond byte 41 in every row. The real source rows were never executed against.
real_defect_replica: T3/T3b/T4 rows reproduce the real rows' bytes 1-39 class masks exactly (asserted), with synthetic digits.
results: PASS T1 CDS-layout fixture -> PASS_DOCUMENTED_LAYOUT(CDS) | PASS_DOCUMENTED_LAYOUT
PASS T2 MRT-layout fixture -> PASS_DOCUMENTED_LAYOUT(MRT) | PASS_DOCUMENTED_LAYOUT
PASS T3 real-spacing replica -> FAILED_SCHEMA_VALIDATION, no values emitted | FAILED_SCHEMA_VALIDATION
PASS T3 replica bytes 1-39 class mask == real-row prefix class mask (both rows) | {"DDO154": "_____AAAAAA_99___9.99__9.99__9_99.9__9.", "NGC3198": "____AAAAAAA__9__99.99__9.99__9_99.9__9."}
PASS T3b V001 on replica -> status OK with malformed literals (defect reproduced) | malformed fields: D,e_D,f_D,Inc,e_Inc e.g. D='5  12.'
PASS T4 replica + pinned declared layout -> PASS_DECLARED_LAYOUT | PASS_DECLARED_LAYOUT
PASS T5 k declared layout wrong sha -> E_DECLARATION_PIN
PASS T5 l declared field beyond byte 41 -> refused | {"status": "FAILED", "code": "E_LAYOUT_FIELD_e_Inc"}
PASS T5 m declaration while a documented layout passes -> FAILED_DECLARATION_CONFLICT
PASS T5 n output exists -> E_OUTPUT_EXISTS
PASS T5 o source pin mismatch -> E_PIN
